question: What is the primary goal of Post-Abortion Care services?

options.A: To replace standard antenatal clinic services
options.B: To reduce maternal mortality and morbidity
options.C: To punish women who undergo illegal procedures
options.D: To promote mandatory sterilization for all patients

explanation: PAC aims to treat complications swiftly to save women's lives and prevent long-term health damage. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T006#GNS226_U5_T006_h1)

question: Why must PAC include emotional and family planning support alongside medical treatment?

options.A: Contraception provision is the only legally mandated part of the PAC model
options.B: Patients refuse physical treatment until counseling sessions are completed
options.C: Physical stabilization alone does not address overall well-being or future health
options.D: Nigerian law requires mandatory counseling for every hospital discharge

explanation: Comprehensive care looks at the whole patient, helping them heal emotionally and prevent unplanned pregnancies. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T006#GNS226_U5_T006_h1)

question: How many core elements make up the standard Post-Abortion Care model?
explanation: The established international PAC framework consists of five distinct components working together. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T006#GNS226_U5_T006_h2)

question: Which component of PAC directly prevents repeat unplanned pregnancies before the patient leaves the facility?

options.A: Reproductive health linkages to external clinics
options.D: Contraceptive services and family planning provision

explanation: Offering birth control methods before discharge ensures patients can protect their future reproductive health. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T006#GNS226_U5_T006_h2)

question: What is Manual Vacuum Aspiration commonly used for during PAC emergency treatment?

options.A: To administer intravenous fluids for severe shock
options.B: To deliver hormonal contraception after a miscarriage
options.C: To evacuate retained products of conception safely
options.D: To screen patients for sexually transmitted infections

explanation: MVA is a standard, safe clinical tool used to clear the uterus of remaining tissue during incomplete abortions. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T006#GNS226_U5_T006_h3)

question: A patient arrives pale, dizzy, and bleeding heavily following an unsafe abortion. What is the immediate nursing priority?

options.A: Wait for laboratory test results before starting treatment
options.B: Secure intravenous access and begin fluid resuscitation
options.C: Conduct a detailed lecture on family planning methods
options.D: Discharge the patient with oral pain relief medications

explanation: Treating life-threatening hemorrhage and shock takes precedence over all other routine nursing duties. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T006#GNS226_U5_T006_h3)

question: Why is maintaining strict confidentiality crucial during post-abortion counseling sessions?

options.A: It builds trust and protects the patient from social stigma
options.B: It ensures that family members never find out about the hospital visit
options.C: It prevents the hospital from keeping medical records on file
options.D: It is legally required only if the pregnancy was terminated illegally

explanation: Patients fear judgment and legal backlash, so confidentiality allows them to speak freely and accept care. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T006#GNS226_U5_T006_h4)

question: Which communication technique is most essential for a nurse providing emotional support to a PAC patient?

options.A: Rushing through the interview to save time
options.B: Sharing personal opinions on moral issues

explanation: Non-judgmental listening encourages open communication and helps patients process emotional trauma safely. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T006#GNS226_U5_T006_h4)

question: When should family planning counseling and method provision ideally occur during post-abortion care?

options.A: Months later during a routine community outreach visit
options.B: Before the patient is discharged from the health facility
options.C: Only after the patient returns for a six-week checkup
options.D: Never, because PAC focuses solely on emergency medical treatment

explanation: Since fertility returns rapidly, initiating contraception before discharge prevents subsequent unwanted pregnancies. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T006#GNS226_U5_T006_h5)

question: What is a major advantage of long-acting reversible contraceptives offered during PAC?

options.A: They provide effective, long-term protection without requiring daily action
options.B: They permanently sterilize the patient on the first day of insertion
options.C: They require surgical removal by a specialist surgeon every single month
options.D: They completely eliminate the risk of contracting sexually transmitted infections

explanation: LARCs offer reliable birth control that users do not have to remember to take every day. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T006#GNS226_U5_T006_h5)

question: Which service is commonly linked to post-abortion care during follow-up linkages?

options.A: Screening for sexually transmitted infections and HIV
options.B: Routine pediatric immunizations for newborn infants
options.C: Emergency trauma care for highway traffic accident victims
options.D: Mandatory major general surgery for all family members

explanation: PAC linkages connect patients to essential wellness checks like STI screenings and HIV testing. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T006#GNS226_U5_T006_h6)

question: Why are community outreach programs important for the success of Post-Abortion Care?

options.A: They educate the public on safe practices and direct women to care early
options.B: They replace the need for emergency hospital wards in rural districts
options.C: They ensure that every pregnant woman undergoes mandatory counseling
options.D: They allow nurses to police local neighborhoods for illegal practitioners

explanation: Community education helps patients recognize danger signs and seek prompt medical help before complications worsen. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T006#GNS226_U5_T006_h6)

question: What is a major consequence of healthcare stigma toward patients seeking post-abortion care?

options.A: Patients request more family planning methods before discharge
options.B: Patients delay seeking care, increasing severe complications and death
options.C: Hospitals receive more funding from international health organizations
options.D: Nurses experience higher job satisfaction in emergency departments

explanation: Fear of judgment and poor treatment drives women away from hospitals until their conditions become life-threatening. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T006#GNS226_U5_T006_h7)

question: How should a nurse handle personal moral beliefs when caring for a PAC patient?

options.A: Report the patient to local law authorities before offering treatment
options.B: Put personal beliefs aside to provide professional, non-judgmental care
options.C: Refuse treatment outright until the patient explains her actions
options.D: Lecture the patient on morality while administering intravenous fluids

explanation: Professional ethics require nurses to prioritize patient health and safety above personal moral viewpoints. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T006#GNS226_U5_T006_h7)
